name: Bay Automotive Distribution Group, Inc.
old_description: We specialize in distributing premium automotive parts, lubricants, filters, additives, and essential maintenance products.
about:
Bay Automotive Distribution Group, Inc. operates from Fremont, California, where it was founded in 2005. The company began as a wholesale automotive distributor serving the Northern California market and has maintained a focus on bulk supply of automotive consumables and components for nearly two decades.

The business distributes premium automotive parts, lubricants, filters, additives, and essential maintenance products. Its core service lines include wholesale automotive parts distribution, bulk motor oils and lubricants (synthetic and conventional engine oils, transmission fluids, greases), and filtration solutions covering air, oil, and fuel filters from recognized brands. The company positions itself as a bulk-rate supplier to retailers and service providers, though facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not disclosed.

Customers span the automotive aftermarket: spare-parts retailers, independent repair workshops, smaller distributors, and entrepreneurs launching automotive businesses. The Indonesian-language site explicitly lists "toko sparepart, bengkel kendaraan, distributor kecil" as typical buyers, confirming a channel-focused model that emphasizes large-quantity orders over retail sales.

The company states its differentiation rests on competitive wholesale pricing, consistent product availability, and a commitment to fast, professional service. It emphasizes partnerships with trusted suppliers and quality-assurance processes to ensure distributed products meet market standards, framing long-term, mutually beneficial relationships as a core operating principle.
